desc: Read the input values N, sequences A and B, and costs C.
Identify the set of indices $M$ where $A_i \neq B_i$.
Separate $M$ into two sets: $S_{10}$ (indices where $A_i=1, B_i=0$) and $S_{01}$ (indices where $A_i=0, B_i=1$).
Calculate the total cost by simulating the optimal order (derived logic):
Dynamic cost for $S_{10}$: Sort $C_i$ ascending, sum $C_i \times (t-1)$ where $t$ goes from $1$ to $|S_{10}|$.
Dynamic cost for $S_{01}$: Sort $C_i$ descending, sum $C_i \times (K - t + 1)$ where $t$ goes from $|S_{10}|+1$ to $K$.
Write the complete Python code to stdin, solve, and print to stdout.
